summary.intent: Plan and begin executing Phase 62 (Unified Node Codec Core Keystone) of the CipherBox project — a full rewrite of the core codec to use unified Node types with dual-sealed bodies, generation-based AAD, and frozen golden vectors.
summary.outcome: Planning completed successfully (9 plans / 7 waves, all verification gates passed), and execution progressed through Wave 1 (node types + vault v3 blob), Wave 2 (AAD-bound seal + frozen vectors, 228/228 tests green), and Wave 3 partial (docs rewrite done, core barrel cutover spawned but not yet complete in the transcript).

repo: Phase 62 is the v2.0 keystone: it rewrites packages/core codec, stubs ~30 consumer files across sdk-core/sdk/web, and freezes cross-language golden vectors in tests/vectors/ for Rust parity in Phase 69.

The monorepo has a dependency chain core→sdk-core→sdk→web that dictates wave ordering; worktrees were skipped because they lack node_modules and the cross-package dist chain is simpler on a single tree.
Vault blob v3 layout is: 0x03 | u16_BE(readLen) | ECIES(rootReadKey) | u16_BE(writeLen) | ECIES(rootWriteKey) — two-key, replacing v2/v1 and removing encryptedRootFolderKey.
Nyquist validation gate requires RESEARCH.md to contain a '## Validation Architecture' section to trigger VALIDATION.md creation; without research this dimension is absent from plans.

plan:pre hooks active on this repo: intel, research, pattern-mapper, schema-gate, tdd, drift (non-blocking). No security or UI gate. schema-gate skips when no ORM files (Prisma/Drizzle/TypeORM/Payload/Supabase) are in scope.
Drift gate fires as 'action_required: warn' but non-blocking (spawn_mapper: false) when the codebase baseline map is stale; /gsd-map-codebase refreshes it but is not required to proceed.
The gsd commit helper reports commit_failed as a false-negative even when the commit lands; git log is the authoritative check.

workflow.auto_advance=true in config would normally chain plan-phase straight into execute-phase; the orchestrator deliberately stopped at 'planned' for a v2.0 keystone before the user confirmed auto-advance.
Consumer test files that import deleted types fail tsc before describe.skip evaluates — imports must be removed, not just test bodies skipped (quarantine must delete or comment out the import lines).
Golden vectors for cross-language parity (Phase-69 Rust) must be committed to tests/vectors/ as files, not inlined in plan YAML — D-04 requirement.
Recent commits use 'docs(62):' and 'feat(62):' scope convention on branch feat/unified-node-codec-core-keystone.

code.finding: sealNode/unsealNode compose the Phase-61 sealAesGcmAad/buildNodeAad primitive; must be frozen before any consumer seals (freeze-first invariant).
Frozen Node wire format: body-bytes primary lock (IV-independent) + fixed-key/fixed-IV full-seal lock. Reuses Phase-61 node_id/IV so Phase-69 Rust test slots in without changes.
Cross-language vector for vault v3 blob layout; committed as a file (not inline) per D-04.
Core barrel cutover in Plan 62-05: drop folder/ and file/ exports, add node/ export, delete legacy directories entirely.
Must be adapted to compile against Node type (behavior stubbed to owning Phase 65, not implemented here); not an ORM schema file so schema-gate skips it.

workflow: GSD plan-phase workflow: Research → VALIDATION.md (Nyquist) → PATTERNS.md → Planner → Checker (up to 3 revision iterations) → coverage gates (requirements + decisions) → STATE.md update → commit → execute-phase.
Pattern-mapper commits PATTERNS.md outside the step-13d commit; must be committed explicitly after the mapper returns (known gap in the workflow).

Plan-checker found 1 blocker + 4 warnings on first pass; all resolved in one revision round (RESEARCH.md (RESOLVED) markers, vector file location, exit-code-safe tsc verify, Plan 08 split into 08a/08b for size).
Splitting a large plan (>40 files) into 08a/08b at verification time adds a wave (7 instead of 6) and de-risks context exhaustion in unsupervised execution.
Sequential execution on main tree (not parallel worktrees) is the right call for wave-ordered monorepo phases with cross-package dist dependencies and pnpm workspaces.
Wave 2 (freeze-first) is a critical milestone gate: full core suite (228 tests) should be run and confirmed green before proceeding to cutover/consumer waves.
--no-transition flag stops the orchestrator at PHASE COMPLETE rather than auto-chaining to Phase 63; appropriate for a v2.0 keystone that warrants human review before the next phase begins.

friction: gsd commit helper reports commit_failed as a false-negative even on successful commits; requires git log verification after every commit to confirm landing.
Node eval in execute-phase init had a quoting bug that misreported worktree mode; required a second bash invocation to get clean output.
Bash word-splitting glitch in the requirements-coverage display printed all six NODE IDs as a single token; required a second clean recheck run to get a trustworthy result.
Drift gate fires 'action_required' but is non-blocking; it generates noise (143 pre-existing elements flagged) with no actionable output for the current phase.
API-surface intel regeneration returned 0 symbols, making it useless for the planner prompt; had to be omitted silently.
executor/feat commits use scope '(62)' not '(62-NN)', so --grep by plan number undercounts in spot-checks; tsc output is the reliable gate instead.
Worktree isolation was considered but rejected due to missing node_modules in worktrees for pnpm monorepos — a recurring gotcha that adds decision overhead.
open_items: Wave 3 Plan 62-05 (core barrel cutover — highest blast radius) was spawned but not yet complete in the transcript; this is the structural keystone that deletes folder/ and file/ and builds core dist/.
Waves 4–7 (sdk-core, sdk, web logic, web components + final pnpm typecheck) not yet started.
Phase 65 owns the real behavior for registry/schema.ts and bin/types.ts; Phase 62 only stubs them to compile.
Phase 69 Rust parity tests need to consume tests/vectors/node-codec.json and tests/vectors/vault-v3-blob.json — frozen here, consumed there.
~30 consumer files across sdk-core/sdk/web need import-swap + stub work across Waves 4–7.
Web quarantine (Wave 7, Plan 62-08b) uses grep-discovery for retired-type imports in test files; coverage depends on grep patterns being complete.
/gsd-map-codebase should be run to refresh the stale codebase baseline map (non-blocking but reduces drift-gate noise in future phases).

PATTERNS.md commit is outside the step-13d workflow commit — this is a known gap in the plan-phase workflow that could cause PATTERNS.md to be missed if the orchestrator fails before the explicit commit.
